title: Sample tracking
seo_description: Barcode sample tracking for diagnostic labs: match every tube to the patient and test, see each handoff, and find any sample by rack and slot.

fields.hero_title: Every tube traced, from collection to rack to report
fields.hero_lead: Scan a barcode to match the tube to the right patient and test, see every step it has passed, and know exactly which rack and slot it sits in. No more searching refrigerators for a sample.
fields.features:
Barcode scan with instant patient match
Timeline from registration to report
Rack maps color-coded by tube type
Hold or reject with the reason recorded
Urgent samples flagged
Live accession queue

steps.title: Label
steps.text: Each tube gets a barcode at the point of collection, matched to the patient and test.

steps.title: Scan every handoff
steps.text: Registered, collected, received, in testing, reported: each step is recorded as it happens.

steps.title: Find it in seconds
steps.text: Look up any sample to see its exact rack and slot, and who handled it last.

fields.cta_title: See sample tracking with your own setup
fields.cta_text: Bring your test menu and price list. We will show you a patient case from registration to signed report, configured the way your team works.
